entity.title: Contributor
entity.description: A person or account that adds Rules and Notes to a Realm, named by a contributor identifier.

rules.body: A contributor identifier IS `<idp>:<subject>`, where `<idp>` names an identity provider and `<subject>` is the contributor's identifier at that provider.
The `<idp>` of a contributor identifier MUST be one of the identity providers listed by core.
The `added_by` of every Rule and Note MUST be a contributor identifier.
A Realm MAY declare its contributors in a `contributors` array of the `realm` object of its manifest.
When a Realm declares contributors, the `added_by` of every new Rule and Note MUST name one of them.
A sub-realm MUST use the contributors of its parent Realm.
A contributor entry MAY hold an email address.
A contributor entry with `<idp>` `github` SHOULD hold the account's numeric user ID.

notes.content: The identity providers listed by core are `github`; later core rules add others.
An OIDC issuer is a provider a later rule could add.
The contributor list is the Realm's trust root. Keys added later attach to its entries, so a Realm controls who may sign without a global PKI.
Email is optional because it is personal data copied into every clone, proves nothing alone and changes; one entry holds it, so it can be removed.
A GitHub login can be renamed or reused; the numeric ID can't.
